note: Re-run after Phase 4 (Kyverno restricted enforcement) went live, to prove Phase 3's capability still works end-to-end rather than assume it. Surfaced a real gap the first two attempts didn't have to deal with: Argo Workflows' emissary-executor injects its own init/wait containers with no securityContext, which no WorkflowTemplate-level setting can cover (allowPrivilegeEscalation/capabilities have no pod-level fallback in the Kubernetes API) -- fixed via executor.securityContext in apps/argo-workflows.yaml. See README.md's Phase 4 notes and git history for the two prior failed attempts this run followed.
